# Beyond the Mountains project instructions

The project instructions for coding agents and contributors are in [`CLAUDE.md`](../CLAUDE.md)
at the repo root. Read it before reviewing or changing anything, and follow it as if it were
written here: it is the single source, so this file doesn't repeat it.

The parts that matter most in a review:

- Work happens on a branch and lands through a pull request with squash-merge; `main` holds
  only clean, finished work.
- The repository is a stand-alone player handbook for the universe: nothing in it refers to
  `scratchpad/` or to other projects' tooling.
- Content is CC BY 4.0 with the exceptions in `LICENSING.md`; code is MIT.
